name: card

source.prompt: One realistic blank premium bank payment card, seen from the front in a mild three-quarter view, long axis horizontal. Matte medium grey polymer face, one real metal contact chip on the left and fine engraved grooves. No bank name, letters, numbers, markings or decorations.

method: Use aligned region mask and original neutral luminance. Model used neutral top-left light. Diffuse = min(1,1.2*luma^0.74), specular shoulder above .80, preserve original alpha and unmasked pixels. Region construction is recorded in palette.ts.
